label: Issue to pull request
definition: The median time from the first queueing or start of a GitHub issue's runs to the end of the first run that delivered it. A run delivers when it succeeded and a push policy decision did not deny it.
exclusions: Runs without readable evidence (older runs, or a file that is missing, too large or a link). Runs without an issue. Issues delivered before the window. Refinement runs.

label: First-pass test success
definition: The share of runs whose first test run (not a baseline run before the work) passed.
exclusions: Runs without readable evidence (older runs, or a file that is missing, too large or a link). Runs with no test result, such as plan-only flows. Refinement runs.

label: Merge rate (pushed work)
definition: The share of work items, in flows that push, that a run delivered. A run delivers when it succeeded and a push policy decision did not deny it.
exclusions: Runs without readable evidence (older runs, or a file that is missing, too large or a link). Flows that never push in the window. Runs that work on no issue, pull request or CI run. Refinement runs.

label: Rework after delivery
definition: The number of work items delivered in the window that a later run worked on again before the end of the window.
exclusions: Runs without readable evidence (older runs, or a file that is missing, too large or a link). Later runs without readable evidence. Items delivered outside the window. Refinement runs.

label: Policy blocks
definition: The number of runs that a policy stopped at least once. The details also give the denials that observed packs would have made.
exclusions: Runs without readable evidence (older runs, or a file that is missing, too large or a link). Refinement runs.

label: Evidence completeness
definition: The share of runs with an evidence file that also have the final manifest and are not marked incomplete.
exclusions: Runs without an evidence file. Refinement runs.

label: Resumes
definition: The number of times the runs of the window were resumed. The details give the share of runs resumed at least once.

label: Approval latency
definition: The mean time from the moment a run waited for an approval to the decision.
exclusions: Runs without readable evidence (older runs, or a file that is missing, too large or a link). Runs with no approval are not counted. Refinement runs.

label: Cost per successful run
definition: The cost of all runs of the window, failed ones included, divided by the number of runs that succeeded.
exclusions: Refinement runs. No value when no run succeeded.
